$comment: ADAAAA-7768 - frame-derived window labels for the SuperTuxKart half of the rights-cleared CC0 onFOSS 2023-09-23 tournament livestream. Labels were read from the pixels only: the race clock digits at native resolution (1 fps), the centre event banner ('Final lap!', 'You finished the race in rank N') and, for the one race whose banner the reader could not resolve, the lap counter going 2/3 -> 3/3. No label comes from decide reason text, from a detection model's output, from any kill-feed/HUD parser (none was built), or from a soccer/football clip. Each instant carries the bracket it was narrowed to; the per-second grid bounds most brackets at 1-2 s and one at 3 s (race D final lap).

video.rights_holder: onFOSS (event organiser publishing its own tournament stream; uploader gnudist@tutanota.com)
video.attribution: onFOSS 2023-09-23 Hypersomnia and STK-Tournament livestream, CC0 1.0, via the Internet Archive
video.audio: aac 48 kHz stereo; caster commentary over game SFX (the bed this type's audio trigger is measured on)
video.frame_source: native 426x240 frames decoded at 1 fps; the race-clock band (x 364-428, y 30-56), the centre banner band (x 120-320, y 60-110) and the grand-prix panel (x 60-170, y 50-180) were cropped per frame and read at 4x-6x Lanczos
video.label_method: race-clock catalogue: every frame of the SuperTuxKart half (t=4380-5731) cropped to the clock/banner/panel bands at 1 fps and read as text; a race start is the instant where (frame time - clock value) is constant across the race's reads, a final lap is the centre banner (or the lap counter's 3/3 transition), a finish is the 'You finished the race in rank N' banner, and non-event windows are 24 s mid-race windows with the clock running at both ends and no labelled instant within +/-10 s.
video.label_confidence_note: The 1 fps grid bounds an instant to 1 s. Race D's final lap is bracketed at 3 s because its banner was not resolvable by the reader and the lap counter transition sits between two frames (5436 -> 5440). The audio harness is scored at its default -3 s/+2 s match window, which covers every bracket in this file.
video.segment_note: Only the SuperTuxKart tournament half is labelled. The earlier Hypersomnia (2D arena shooter) half carries no label-grade event channel at 426x240 and is NOT labelled, so fires there are outside the labelled window and are reported separately rather than counted as certified false positives.

coverage.floor_note: the issue's floor is >=15 objective events and >=10 non-event windows; met at 15 and 13 on 833 s of one grand prix across five races. Read narrowly (only start + finish count as objective events, laps do not) the set is 10 events and misses the floor; that reading is stated in RESULTS.md so the margin is not smuggled in.
